calibration.surprise_note: H10 paired mean delta was positive and stable across chronological halves, but the overlapping-event moving-block interval crossed zero and the cooldown first half was slightly negative.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The treatment diversified away from an RSI baseline concentrated in NFLX and MCD and selected names with stronger absorption and captured-chain put concentration. Positive deltas survived both H10 halves and leave-one-ticker-out checks, but overlapping events, vintage leakage, and weak cooldown first-half behavior keep the evidence at lead grade.
